description: Type Composer's 400 for an environment that is busy. Observed live 2026-10-29: deleting an environment right after restartWebServer or saveSnapshot answers 400 'Cannot delete environment in state UPDATING. Environment must be in RUNNING or ERROR state.' It surfaced as an out-of-union BadRequest, so a provider could not wait the update out with a typed retry.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The environment is busy (creating, updating or being deleted) and can't take this change yet (HTTP 400: 'Cannot delete environment in state ...'). Retryable once the operation finishes.

message.includes: Environment must be in RUNNING or ERROR state
